profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary:
Leadership – Commitment – Humility – Excellence

We are defined by the conversations we have, the decisions we make, and the actions we take.  These are a set of choices made by following a set of core principles and values.  Happiness is having the courage to be true to our values and live as our true selves.

Gratitude, this is the word I would use to describe how fortunate I am to live in a world where the opportunities are boundless.  I am living proof that it is never too late to explore career opportunities and seek a career you love.  My journey took me through two bachelor degrees, multiple cities and states, and several industries including Food Production, Oil and Gas, Entrepreneurship, and Aerospace and Defense.  Ultimately, I found my true passion in software development and technologies.

From childhood, I have loved solving puzzles and dreaming up ideas for games.  Even today, when not taking courses or professionally developing software, I am developing game projects in my free time.  I especially take pride and ownership in everything that I work on.

Beyond my career, I thrive around people.  Improving my expertise in dance and body movement has been a lifelong hobby with a solid focus on fundamentals.  Time is the most valuable resource, and I always make sure I make the most of it.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Primary contributor to integrating a new MTS-B EO/IR sensorball support for CAE's Predator Mission Trainer (PMT).  Quickly ramped up on made strong contributions to various subsystems refactoring legacy code introducing robust state machines and command/status handling.  Quickly resolved critical issues identified product owners needed for product delivery.

Strong contributor to development of CAE's F/A-18 Super Hornet training systems.  Primary contributions include implementing new solutions, understanding and refactoring legacy code, and analyzing and resolving software discrepencies critical to program success.  Keen problem-solving skills are required with deep understanding of the system architecture to properly analyze and uncover root cause.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer implementing software changes for Multi-Spectral Targeting Systems (MTS), the product family of choice for U.S. military imaging and targeting systems.  Focused on providing maximum benefit and impact to team and organization by delivering software changes critical to mission success.  Collaborating to solve problems in several complex subsystems which require a broad understanding of underlying design and algorithms.  Often, solutions require more than addressing the issue but also making changes to improve repeatability, maintainability, and performance.  Domain knowledge include: tracking, image stabilization, and laser subsystems.

Beyond technical contributions, leadership activities include spearheading an new Six Sigma project to develop in-house tool to improve productivity across multiple teams, aiding several teams in transition to new source code management and tools, and build manager activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description: Explored and developed external Hololens client application to interface with API and services provided by existing software architecture using OOP, multi-threading, and various programming design patterns to maintain modular, cohesive code.  Developed in C# and Unity3D while interfacing with services through various network protocols.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
positions.description:
Developed software as a full-time software engineering co-op on an internal research and development team for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) aircraft.  Fixed bugs and implemented features following requirements and designed system architecture.  Worked on two deliverable products on Windows and Web-based platform.  Developed primarily in C#, JavaScript, and HTML.  Reported daily activities following Scrum Agile software development life cycle.  Developed code with a focus on reuseability, modularity, maintainability and expandability

Developed software tools for internal use spanning two different projects designed through OOP using responsibility-driven methodology.  Analyzed and designed controller, boundary, and entity objects in program.  Implementation for Linux environment with Bash, Python, and Perl scripts.  Worked alongside many different teams for alpha testing code.  Interfaced code with CLIs and APIs for various servers and tools.

positions.title: REALTOR
positions.description: Developed leadership and marketing skills with a keen customer focus.  Built trust and demonstrated value through focused execution operating with honesty and integrity.  Demonstrated strong interpersonal, oral and written communication skills interfacing with a wide variety of customers.

positions.title: MWD/LWD Field Specialist III
positions.description: Led onsite logging and surveying operations while drilling.  Resolved a variety of software and hardware failures during the drilling process.  Interpreted technical results to navigate directional drilling activities.  Worked closely with customer, third-party operators, technicians and engineers.  Excelled in high pace, high pressure field environment with high value clients

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

honors.description: Peer-nominated honoree recognized among top 3% of technical performers
